final: WITH hand_tallies AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_tallies), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
